review.eventDescription: One guest review of an Agoda property: 0-10 rating (and out of 5), rating word, title, text, positives and negatives, language and the original text where Agoda translated it, review and stay dates, room, reviewer name and country, helpful votes, photos, source (Agoda or Booking.com) and the hotel's reply with date (row keys rating, rating_5, rating_text, title, text, positives, negatives, language, original_text, review_date, check_in, check_out, room_type, reviewer_name, reviewer_country, helpful_votes, images, source, response, response_date): $5 per 1,000 reviews. Not charged: hotel rows, status rows, reviews removed by maxRating or requireText, a property given twice (name, URL and id of one hotel are read once), properties with no reviews, names or URLs that match nothing, bad input. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. Agoda pages about 100 reviews at a time; a mid-size hotel has a few hundred, a busy hostel over a thousand. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.
